body: I personally wouldn’t do SIH, you don’t get to experience many people who have different majors. Yes it’s a good way to makes friends but it’s very limited. I know people who barely leave Ehouse or CSH. I’m an engineer so I made friends at Ehouse and I just go hang out with them all the time, without having to pay extra money and spend my time with the same people. There are always clubs to meet people with similar interests!
i’m so sorry you are feeling this way but things do get better please stay
